subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: Fly direct to Beijing with Philippine Airlines for five nights in 5-star hotels. See Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City, the Juyongguan Great Wall and the Temple of Heaven, and try skiing at Snow World with ticket, snow coat and equipment included. Day 5 is free and easy, with Universal Studios Beijing as an optional day.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Feb 18–23 2027 to Feb 28–Mar 5 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Water Cube: The Beijing National Aquatics Centre from the 2008 Olympics, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's National Stadium with its steel lattice design, built for the 2008 Olympics and seen from outside.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Street: A famous Beijing shopping and snack street, visited on the evening of arrival.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: One of the largest public squares in the world, in the heart of Beijing.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The former imperial palace of Ming and Qing emperors in Beijing.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-known section of the Great Wall north of Beijing, set in a mountain pass.
placeDesc.Snow World: A ski area near the Great Wall visit; the tour includes the ticket, snow coat and ski equipment.
placeDesc.Temple of Heaven: A Ming-era temple complex in Beijing where emperors held ceremonies for good harvests.
placeDesc.Qianmen Street: A restored traditional shopping street south of Tiananmen Square.
placeDesc.Summer Palace: A former imperial garden with a lake and pavilions in Beijing; optional tour, boat cruise not included.
placeDesc.Universal Studios Beijing: A theme park resort in Beijing, visited on the optional free-day tour.
